storyCards.headline: Viva La Vida: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Coldplay's "Viva La Vida" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 51 weeks on the chart.

Viva La Vida was released in 2008.

Album: Viva La Vida or Death And All His Friends (2008).
